key_nodes: Tessellation: Covering a surface completely without gaps or overlaps
Shapes that tessellate: Squares, rectangles, regular hexagons, equilateral triangles
Non-tessellating shapes: Circles, regular pentagons, irregular curved shapes
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Believing all regular polygons tessellate seamlessly on a flat plane.

key_nodes: Triangle classification: Equilateral (3 equal sides), Isosceles (2 equal sides), Scalene (0 equal sides)
Quadrilaterals: Square, Rectangle, Rhombus, Parallelogram, Trapezium
Polygons by side count: Pentagon (5), Hexagon (6), Octagon (8)
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Polygon: A closed 2D shape composed entirely of straight line segments.

key_nodes: Cube Net: 6 square faces unfolding into flat pattern
Regular Dodecahedron (12 pentagonal faces) & Icosahedron (20 triangular faces)
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Euler's Polyhedron Formula: Faces (F) + Vertices (V) - Edges (E) = 2.
